text: Hmm?
zh: 嗯？

text: Are you looking for something to hunt?
zh: 你是在找猎物吗？

text: If so, I'd have to disappoint you.
zh: 如果是，那我只能让你失望了。

text: Except for a few birds, there's nothing left here.
zh: 除了几只鸟，这里已经什么都不剩了。

text: Who are you?
zh: 你是谁？

text: What are you doing?
zh: 你在做什么？

text: Did you see Themir lately?
zh: 你最近见过塞米尔吗？

text: What do you know about bows?
zh: 你对弓了解多少？

text: Can you teach me something?
zh: 你能教我点什么吗？

text: Teach me.
zh: 教教我。

text: Do you have something to sell?
zh: 你有东西卖吗？

text: See you!
zh: 回见！

text: Was on a long hunt, but with no kill.
zh: 出去打了很久的猎，却一无所获。

text: I am working on my bows, at the moment.
zh: 我眼下正在打理我的弓。

text: The old codger?
zh: 那个老家伙？

text: No, I haven't seen him in a while.
zh: 没有，我有阵子没见到他了。

text: He is missing.
zh: 他失踪了。

text: Really?
zh: 真的？

text: I am being told nothing out here, it seems.
zh: 看来在这荒郊野外，什么消息都传不到我耳朵里。

text: Themir did not pass this way, if that is what you were wondering.
zh: 塞米尔没有从这条路经过，如果你想问的是这个。

text: Enough to be an efficient hunter.
zh: 足以让我做个称职的猎手。

text: On this side of the river, I'm the only bowyer.
zh: 在河的这一边，我是唯一的制弓匠。

text: The people in the camp lack a certain... delicacy, when it comes to this craft.
zh: 营地里的人在这门手艺上缺少某种……细腻。

text: I could show you a few things, yes.
zh: 我可以教你几手，没问题。

text: As the woods are barren, there is nothing to do besides sharpen my craft. Sharing it with you would prove beneficial to both of us.
zh: 林子里已无猎物，除了磨练手艺，我也无事可做。把它传授给你，对你我都有好处。

text: But it won't be without its price. Knowledge and expertise requires sacrifice.
zh: 但这不会是白给的。知识与技艺都需要付出代价。

text: In your case, 100 gold will be a sufficient one.
zh: 对你来说，100金币就足够了。

text: You ask a lot.
zh: 你要价不低啊。

text: Fine, here's your gold. (100 gold)
zh: 好吧，钱给你。（100金币）

text: Maybe later.
zh: 以后再说吧。

text: As I've said, the value of knowledge and skill outweighs material possessions.
zh: 我说过，知识与技艺的价值远胜身外之物。

text: Also, I'm the only one who can teach you.
zh: 再说，能教你的也只有我一个。

text: Thank you.
zh: 谢谢。

text: Talk to me if you need training.
zh: 需要训练就来找我。

text: Work on your dexterity, and you'll be able to handle stronger bows.
zh: 磨练你的敏捷，你就能驾驭更强的弓。

text: What do you wish to know?
zh: 你想学些什么？

text: Improve bow skills (min. 4 DEX) [2 AP]#args:{"hint":"ui_dialogue_hint_skill_bow_weapon_training_10","only_once_on_difficulty": true}
zh: 提升弓术（需敏捷4）[2 技能点]#args:{"hint":"ui_dialogue_hint_skill_bow_weapon_training_10","only_once_on_difficulty": true}

text: Better aiming. (min. 4 DEX) [2 AP]#args:{"hint":"ui_dialogue_hint_skill_missile_aiming_20","only_once_on_difficulty": true}
zh: 更精准的瞄准。（需敏捷4）[2 技能点]#args:{"hint":"ui_dialogue_hint_skill_missile_aiming_20","only_once_on_difficulty": true}

text: Nothing.
zh: 不用了。

text: I am #:Shrike:#, the only hunter out here.
zh: 我是#:什里克:#，这一带唯一的猎人。

text: Out-of-work hunter to be honest.
zh: 说实话，是个无活可干的猎人。

text: Doesn't leave you with much choice.
zh: 那你也没什么别的选择了。

text: I have a few bows to spare. Have a look.
zh: 我这儿有几把多余的弓。看看吧。

text:
First of all, you have to stretch the bowstring of your bow to the limit.
Hold the string near your mouth for better aiming.
zh:
首先，你要把弓弦拉到极限。
把弦贴近嘴边，这样瞄得更准。

text: Align the tip of your arrow with your target and release.
zh: 让箭尖对准目标，然后放箭。

text: In case you miss your first shot, make sure to aim a bit more to the side.
zh: 如果第一箭没中，记得往旁边多偏一点再瞄。

text: Keep a cool head while aiming and take a deep breath before releasing your arrow.
zh: 瞄准时保持冷静，放箭前先深吸一口气。

text: Practice that, and you'll be able to hit most targets.
zh: 勤加练习，你就能射中大多数目标。

text:
Take these arrows.
You'll need them for your training.
zh:
拿上这些箭。
训练时用得上。
